To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the thermal rearrangement reaction of N-allylnitrosamine in N,N-dialkylanilines proceeds via a concerted mechanism.
the thermal Claisen rearrangement of N -allyl- N -tosylaniline in N, N -dibutylaniline in the presence of triphenyl-phosphine is a convenient route to N -substituted indolines and N -tosylindolines.
the reaction of 1-allyl-2,6-dichlorobenzene and 1-allylnaphthalene with sodium amide in liquid ammonia gives the corresponding 2-allylnaphthylamine and 2-(1-propenyl)naphthylamine, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new synthetic routes to amines, which are important building blocks for organic chemistry.
the synthesis of new compounds with potential pharmacological activity.
the development of new, efficient methods of synthesis of biologically active substances and the study of their structure and properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the reaction of N-allylaniline and N-allyl-tosylamine with triphenylphos- phine in N,N-dimethylaniline is a very efficient and convenient method for the synthesis of 2-methylindole.
the reaction proceeds by way of an intramolecular attack of the allyl group on the N-tosyl group.
the rearrangement of N-tosylamines to N-tosylindolines proceeds through the amide-Claisen rearrangement of N,N-dialkyl-N-tosylamines.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the thermal amide-Claisen rearrangement is a reaction of the 1,5- or the 1,6-shift of the allyl group.
the rearrangement proceeds by a mechanism involving the formation of a zwitterion.

the rearrangement of N-tosylanilines to 1-tosyl-2-alkylanilines is the most important reaction of the amide-Claisen rearrangement. (auth.) The main takeaway from our work is that
the Claisen rearrangement is a useful reaction to form new C-C bonds.

the Amide-Claisen rearrangement is an efficient method for the preparation of a wide range of 2-alkenyl- and 2-aryl-2,3-dihydrobenzofuran-3-ols and -3-ones, which can be further functionalized to provide a diverse set of compounds.
the Claisen rearrangement can be used as a tool to make a wide variety of substituted styrenes, and that the reaction conditions can be tailored to make the desired product.
